lessons.note: LLM must be prompted to return ONLY a JSON object; stripFences utility handles code-fence wrapping
Compaction must be best-effort (non-blocking) — if LLM synthesis fails, skip and retry next tick rather than crashing the agent loop
Section parser must handle arbitrary heading order, missing sections, and empty activity log gracefully; nil return on malformed state prevents data loss

next: Commit the staged changes, push the branch, and open a PR for review by Head of Org Engineering. Then test compaction end-to-end by running enough ticks to exceed the 30-entry threshold.
state_delta: Added state_compact.go (compaction logic), state_compact_test.go (tests), and wired compactState() call into writeback.go
summary: Implemented STATE.md compaction to prevent unbounded growth. Created state_compact.go with LLM-based synthesis: when the activity log exceeds 30 entries, compactState() calls the model via synthesizeState() to condense the log into structured Shipped/In Flight/Decisions sections, preserving Mission verbatim, then truncates to the 5 most recent entries. Added parseStateSections() for robust section extraction, backup to STATE.md.bak, and best-effort error handling (skips compaction if LLM fails). Wrote state_compact_test.go with 7 tests covering parsing variants, threshold behavior, missing/malformed files, and activity log preservation. Hooked compaction into writeBack() so it runs after every tick.
